content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ICAR IARI Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for ICAR IARI?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Young Professional-II (YP-II) posts at ICAR IARI is scheduled for 01 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they attend on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the eligibility criteria for the Young Professional-II posts?
faq.answer: Candidates should be postgraduates in relevant subjects or graduate degree holders in relevant Agricultural Sciences, Engineering, Technology, Business Administration, or Humanities. Specific desirable subjects and experience are also mentioned.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for these positions?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Young Professional-II posts is between 21 years and 45 years, with age relaxation applicable as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional-II posts?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 42,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies for the Young Professional-II (YP-II) posts.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for ICAR IARI recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process for these positions will be based on a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the ICAR Indian Agricultural Research Institute (ICAR IARI) office in New Delhi.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, and experience certificates.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any specific post code mentioned for the vacancies?
faq.answer: Yes, the vacancies are identified by post codes: NMHYS-SST-01, NMHYS-SST-02, NMHYS-SST-03, and NMHYS-SST-04.
